Métricas HIS\n\n- **HIS_raw** $=1-|\\Delta|/|\\langle H\\rangle_{id}|$ (no invariante a $cI$)\n- **HIS_span** $=1-|\\Delta|/(\\lambda_{max}-\\lambda_{min})$ (métrica primaria)\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"a5912c6e-aa83-4d93-b437-e682545b4562","cell_type":"code","source":"def his_raw(h_id, h_re):\n    d = abs(h_id)\n    return float(\"nan\") if d < EPS else 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / d\n\ndef his_span(h_id, h_re, span):\n    return 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / span\n\ndef z_diff(a, sa, b, sb):\n    s = math.sqrt(sa**2 + sb**2)\n    return float(\"nan\") if (s < EPS or math.isnan(s)) else (a - b) / s\n\ndef group_stats(counts, op, n):\n    labels = op.paulis.to_labels()\n    coeffs = np.real(op.coeffs)\n    vals, cnt = [], []\n    for bs, c in counts.items():\n        s = bs.replace(\" \", \"\")[-n:].zfill(n)\n        e = 0.0\n        for lab, w in zip(labels, coeffs):\n            par = 0\n            for i, ch in enumerate(lab):\n                if ch != \"I\" and s[i] == \"1\":\n                    par ^= 1\n            e += w * (1 - 2 * par)\n        vals.append(e)\n        cnt.append(c)\n    cnt = np.array(cnt, float)\n    shots = max(cnt.sum(), 1.0)\n    return np.array(vals), cnt / shots, int(shots)\n\ndef estimate_energy(groups_counts, groups_ops, n):\n    h, var = 0.0, 0.0\n    for counts, op in zip(groups_counts, groups_ops):\n        v, p, shots = group_stats(counts, op, n)\n        m = float(p @ v)\n        h += m\n        var += float(p @ (v**2) - m**2) / max(shots, 1)\n    return h, math.sqrt(max(var, 0.0))\n\nprint(\"métricas OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T12:37:28.571256Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T12:37:28.572205Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T12:37:28.585908Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T12:37:28.572168Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T12:37:28.584663Z"},"jupyter":{"source_hidden":true}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"métricas OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":48},{"id":"4d0de0fb-a109-465f-ad56-d358ac7d9d31","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 3. t.append((plabel(n, {i: l, i + 1: l}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.5))))\n        for i in range(n):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: l}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.4))))\n    return self.time_drift = time_drift\n        self.r = r\n        self._tick = 0\n\n    def snapshot(self, tls, jit):\n        j = (lambda: self.r.lognormal(0, jit, self.M)) if jit > 0 else (lambda: np.ones(self.M))\n        drift = 1.0 + self.time_drift * (self._tick / 20.0) * self.r.normal(0, 1, self.M)\n        self._tick += 1\n        return dict(\n            t2=np.where(tls, 40.0, self.t2b)  nm = NoiseModel(basis_gates=[\"rz\", \"sx\", \"x\", \"cx\"])\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            nm.add_quantum_error(depolarizing_error(float(true[\"p1\"][q]), 1), [\"sx\", \"x\"], [q])\n Usa índices (evita CircuitError de clbits).\"\"\"\n    from qiskit import QuantumCircuit as QC\n    qs = set(int(q) for q in qubits)\n    nq, nc = tc.num_qubits, tc.num_clbits\n    new = QC(nq, nc)\n    q_index = {bit: idx for idx, bit in enumerate(tc.qubits)}\n    c_index = {bit: idx for idx, bit in enumerate(tc.clbits)}\n    added = 0\n    for inst in tc.data:\n        op = inst.operation\n new.delay(half, qargs[0], unit=unit)\n                new.x(qargs[0])\n                new.delay(half, qargs[0], unit=unit)\n                added += 2\n                continue\n        new.append(op, qargs, cargs)\n    return new, added\n\ndef _force_cpmg_prefix(tc, qubits):\n    \"\"\"Si no hay delays útiles, antepone CPMG corto por qubit (misma intención DD).\"\"\"\n    from
